Post Matric Scholarship for Engineering Students Maharashtra

Department of Higher Education & Social Justice, Government of Maharashtra.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra state.

2. Annual family income must be less than or equal to 2.5 lakh INR per annum.

3. Candidate must be pursuing undergraduate engineering course in a recognized university.

Benefits

100% tuition fee waiver and monthly maintenance allowance credited directly via DBT.

Required Documents

Aadhaar card, Domicile certificate, Income certificate, Mark sheet.
